Direction the mean wind blows from, with speed. Uses all current filters.

Source: NOAA NCEI IGRA 2.2, station USM00074794, nominal launch times as archived. soundings passed quality checks. Soundings that ended below 400 hPa, or had an implausible surface pressure, were excluded.

Parcel method: the Lifted Index, Thompson Index, MLCAPE/MLCIN, LCL/LFC/EL heights and the CAPE-based composites use a 100 hPa mean-layer parcel with virtual-temperature correction. SBCAPE and MUCAPE are shown for reference; a small number of soundings carry implausibly high surface dewpoints that inflate those two.

Latest sounding: read from latest.json, which the included GitHub Actions workflow refreshes hourly from the University of Wyoming archive, with NOAA IGRA2 as a backup.

Winds are in knots; heights are above ground level unless noted. Values are quantized to 1/65,535 of each parameter's range for this page.
